name: Mean-Square Error Metric for Scalar Fields
definition: An error metric comparing the original scalar field to a downsampled approximation by summing squared difference values at all original sample points within a tetrahedron.
summary: The Mean-Square Error Metric quantifies scalar field approximation error within a tetrahedron by summing squared differences across all sample points, unlike isovalue-restricted metrics that limit refinement to regions near the isosurface.
